{{Quote|We suspect remnants of an asteroid mining operation in the Udine system revolted and formed a pirate band. As they were aware of the hyperlane shortcut through nearby Keller's Void, they began towing immense asteroids to block starships and force them out of hyperspace.|[[Blissa Vlix]]|<ref name="QS">{{Wizards|url=default.asp?x=starwars/article/sw20030828web|text=Quick Starfields}}</ref>}}
'''Keller's Void''' was an empty area of the [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim]] used as a shortcut between the [[Calus system/Legends|Calus]] and [[Wroona system/Legends|Wroona]] [[Star system/Legends|systems]]. It was named for [[Keller]], the [[Merchant/Legends|trader]] who discovered it.<ref name="TVT">{{JournalCite|3|The Void Terror}}</ref>

[[File:Kellers_Void.jpg|thumb|right|250px|Keller's Void was a shortcut between the [[Calus system/Legends|Calus system]] and the [[Wroona system/Legends|Wroona system]]]]
The [[Hyperspace route/Legends|route]] ran along the border between the [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim]] and the [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region]]. Its endpoints terminated at the [[Corellian Trade Spine/Legends|Corellian Trade Spine]] at [[Calus]], and at the [[Rimma Trade Route/Legends|Rimma Trade Route]] at [[Wroona/Legends|Wroona]].<ref name="The Essential Atlas">''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' &mdash; Based on the placements of Calus and Wroona on the Inner Rim map</ref> The starliner ''[[Kooba's Pride]]'' traveled along the route, and was attacked by [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]].
